function.name: list_history
function.description: List CMS history using paging and optional filters.

pageNr.description: Positive integer page number, default 1. Increment by 1 to continue.

pageSize.description: Positive integer number of logs per page, default 50, maximum 200. Larger values are capped at 200.

actionType.description: Optional CMS action type, such as Add, Update, or Delete.

storeName.description: Optional CMS store name. Use Table to select all dynamic-table logs.

userId.description: Optional ID of the user who made the change.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
